name: Untimely Malfunction
clause: • Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'change-target'; target: TargetSpec; how: 'change-one' | 'change-all' | 'choose-new'; singleTargetOnly?: boolean }
needs.semantics: Re-aim a spell or ability already on the stack. `how` distinguishes CR 115.7a-d: 'change the target' must move to a DIFFERENT legal target, 'choose new targets' may leave any unchanged. `singleTargetOnly` is the common 'with a single target' restriction.
